description: NOAA's Weather and Climate Toolkit is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information. Download or launch this platform-independent tool to help you sift through and visualize gigabytes of weather and climate data. The Weather and Climate Toolkit offers a first step to getting the multiple time steps in weather and climate data files into a workable format. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Extreme Heat, Flooding – General, Landslides. Assets: Agriculture and Food Supply, Energy and Utilities, Natural Areas and Wildlife, People, Property. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
